## Denise Carter — City Council District 1

- **Agent:** `.claude/agents/civic-office-council-d1/`
- **Address:** Present an economic recovery plan for West Oakland addressing depressed RetailVitality (5.01) and elevated CrimeIndex (1.10).

- **Silence consequence:** Continued economic slide in West Oakland commercial corridors without targeted legislative intervention.
